usage: 滑雪 (ski) can be used as a noun to talk about the sport or activity itself.
It often appears after a verb to describe the action of skiing.
You can use it to describe going to the mountains to 'go skiing'.
In casual conversations, 滑雪 can also imply the experience or event of skiing.
It can be combined with location words to specify where someone goes skiing.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dung1 tin1 heoi3 jat6 bun2 waat6 syut3.
examples.meaning: I go skiing in Japan during winter.
